# Security policy

## Supported version

The deployed `main` branch is the only supported version of this public site.

## Reporting

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository. Do not open a
public issue containing an unpatched vulnerability, credential, token, private
document, or proprietary SAGE implementation detail.

This repository contains only the nonproprietary public site. The SAGE product
implementation and private evidence are out of scope and must not be copied into
an issue or pull request.
